title: Dust Valley Ultra
description: Big desert Ultra 4 park (~16 km). Long course follows the 2024 CA300 Race Ready path (~74 mi, nearly 1:1 fit) with danger-inspired g-outs/rocks/washouts, plus a ~5 mi short course in the middle and side rock trails.
features: CA300-inspired long course, short course, pit row, danger markers, side rock trails
suitablefor: Ultra 4, desert racing, CA300-style prerunning, short-course practice, light rock crawling
roads: Packed desert long/short race corridors with dirt berms; no paved highway network
biome: Arid desert mesa / wash country (Lucerne-area inspired)

spawnPoints.description: Flat staging / pit row area. Default start.
Inner ~5 mile short course in the middle of the park.
Technical rock trail off the east side.
Northwest rocky climb and shelf trail.
